title: Green the trunk so the live run can be measured

completion_criteria.text: The scanner stops reporting the recorded run's runKey, suppressed by field shape and not by path, proven by a full-history scan before and after with both total counts and a positive control.
The composed implement prompt leaves an empty git status in a unit worktree ignored only by the trailing-slash form, red on the parent, green after, and red again under an inertness mutation.
The test job becomes a required status check on main, done only after the prompt fix merges, so a red pull request can no longer merge on a single click.

spine.active_goal: Clear the three prerequisites that make the next billed live run worth paying for: a truthful secret scanner, a prompt that leaves no artifact, and a test job that can block a red merge.
spine.next_step: Only c3 remains and it needs no human: make the test job a required status check on main, now safe because the trunk is green at 41532e17. Nothing is denied there, so it is one API call plus a read-back to confirm it took. After that the thread closes and the front returns to the parent's c45, a live run reaching a merged trunk, which is still unproven. Two human steps sit outside this thread: setting MITOSIS_LIVE_GH_TOKEN, and ruling on the filed receipt-versus-configuration gap.
spine.last_session: 2026-08-22: c1 and c2 both landed. The trunk is green on tests and security at 41532e17, with only the live-GitHub lane red for its absent token. Two accidents were absorbed: a swallowed follow-up commit and a receipt gate collision.

open_risks.text: The scanner check on the gitleaks fix's own pull request does not exercise the fix — it diffs the base tip against the head, and the offending commit is already on the trunk, so its green is not evidence
Do not make the test job required before the prompt fix is merged — it is genuinely red on main today, so requiring it first would block every pull request including the fix's own

Read this suite's verdict from CI rather than any local run — the primary checkout is the only honest local reader, a fresh clone adds fourteen false failures, and a linked worktree censuses an empty set
A config-only or test-only diff short-circuits the receipts enforcer to a fast pass with the mutation referee never running — read that as the gate declining to referee, never as a cleared gate
MITOSIS_LIVE_GH_TOKEN is absent and the workflow refuses to skip silently — the live GitHub lane has never run in CI, it is a human step, and it gates whether the next billed run is worth paying for
Teardown's unbounded directory removal is still live — it deleted a directory outside the repository and returned success, and three call sites still reach it including the one wired as a port

key_decisions.title: The node_modules bootstrap is hidden in the git exclude file, not in the tracked ignore file
A scanner config ships as a tracked downgrade, because no honest in-suite test exists for it

out_of_scope: The parent's c45, a live run reaching a merged trunk; this thread clears its prerequisites and stops
The three items filed above the predecessor's ceiling: the last-allowed-revision scenario, the harness built-wait race, and the four dispatch kinds that carry no unit
Stale mitosis worktrees and squash-landed branches, which are housekeeping rather than correctness
